title: Chapter 337: The Methods Of Outsiders
content:
Chapter 337: The Methods Of Outsiders

In the sphere of influence of the evil god camp in this world, the sky was surging with wind and clouds, and huge space transmission channels appeared out of thin air, hanging high above the sky.

Angels, dragons, demons, elemental elves and various powerful races appeared in this world through those space transmission channels that appeared out of thin air.

The strength of these powerful races is almost all above seven stars, and a large number of powerful people descended at the same time.

The rule will of this world discovered an abnormality, and the whole world was shaking, with lightning and thunder, but it could not mobilize its strength to attack those invading foreign enemies.

The rule will of the world constantly tried to suppress the strength of foreign creatures, but in addition to suppressing the strength of those powerful foreign people, foreign creatures below the powerful level seemed to have some kind of immunity, and the rule will of the world could not affect them.

The rule will of the world, which sensed the danger, immediately relaxed the suppression of the strength of all races in the local camp, and even allowed the powerful people in the local camp to have the authority to go all out in this world.

In order to deal with powerful foreign enemies, the rule will of the world no longer cared about the originally fragile state of this world.

The army of the evil god camp, which was composed of all the strong men, joined the battle and immediately curbed the crazy offensive of the local army.

Although the Zerg and Protoss armies were strong, they were not yet able to reach the lineup of all the strong men. They could not resist the evil god camp, which now used strong men as ordinary soldiers.

While Wu Qing increased the hatching and manifestation of the seven-star and above arms of the Zerg and Protoss, he personally led the powerful men of the Zerg and Protoss to kill all the way to the locations of various space transmission channels.

In this world, Wu Qing no longer had an opponent of equal strength.

No one could resist the team of strong men led by Wu Qing. Although there were many foreign strong men who were suppressed by the will of the world rules, they were all vulnerable.

Wherever Wu Qing passed, countless foreign strong men turned into light and disappeared.

Seeing Wu Qing and the powerful Zerg and Protoss take action, the powerful men of various powerful men above the local camp, who were reminded by the will of the world rules, began to follow Wu Qing's footsteps and took the initiative to attack the foreign strong men.

Even those powerful weird lords who were originally neutral have joined the team to fight against foreign enemies.

Just like the weird lord of the Endless Mountains said, weirdness is actually the life of the local world. After the foreign force was basically eliminated by Wu Qing using the system, those powerful weird lords got rid of the influence of foreign forces and truly possessed the ability to be independent.

For the weird lords, they also don’t want foreign forces to occupy this world. No matter what, the rules and will of this world will eventually favor the life of this world, which is much better than foreign unknown forces.

The world’s rules and will no longer limit the strength of the local life of this world. The strong men from all sides can act at will. They took Wu Qing as an example and played a huge role, becoming the mainstay of resisting the invasion of foreign strong men.

Wu Qing’s eleven-star strength almost exerted a combat power close to twelve stars. Every time he took action, he would destroy a large number of space transmission channels opened by the sacrifice of the evil god camp.

Those powerful foreign race armies were as vulnerable as ordinary armies in front of Wu Qing. Wu Qing could destroy countless foreign race warriors with just one thought.

With the support of the will of the world rules, the powerful warriors of various races in the local camp, all exerted their extremely strong combat power, assisting the Zerg and Protoss armies with an increasing proportion of powerful warriors to resist the attacks of foreign warriors.

Wu Qing took a ten-star Protoss transport ship and could quickly reach various areas within the sphere of influence of the evil god camp. He gave priority to destroying the space transmission channels of the powerful foreign races in the evil god camp, and gradually eliminated the advantages gained by the large-scale sacrifice of the evil god camp.

With the Zerg and Protoss armies as the main force, and the powerful warriors of various races in the local camp as the auxiliary force, the armies of various races in the local camp cooperated to stabilize the fierce attacks of the foreign race warriors in the early stage.

As Wu Qing continues to attack, the advantages of the evil god camp will gradually disappear, and the local camp will soon turn the tide again.

The Zerg and Protoss will only become stronger and stronger in such a war. Countless foreign races have brought countless system resources to Wu Qing.

With sufficient system resources, the Zerg and Protoss will hatch and materialize more and more seven-star and above arms.

With enough seven-star and above Zerg and Protoss arms participating in the war, Wu Qing slowed down the speed of destroying the alien race space transmission channel.

When the strength of the two camps reached a certain balance, Wu Qing stopped destroying the alien race space transmission channel and stabilized the situation. The more foreign races came, the happier Wu Qing was.

Wu Qing used the powerful armies of the Zerg and Protoss to continuously consume the troops of foreign races to develop and strengthen the Zerg and Protoss.

The will of the world rules, desperately supporting Wu Qing and the local camp, finally successfully resisted a powerful offensive of foreign forces.

The very powerful army in this world may not be a big deal in the eyes of those evil gods from the outside world.

A large number of powerful foreign warriors died in this world. No one knows what mysterious means those evil gods have used. The rules and will of this world are becoming increasingly weaker in suppressing the power of powerful foreign warriors.

When the foreign warriors were able to exert their great power in this world, the battle between the great warriors of the two camps was so fierce that the sky collapsed and the earth cracked, and the whole world felt unstable.

"Boom... Boom...!"

The great warriors of the local camp and the evil god camp began to attack with all their strength, and the entire front was filled with terrible space shocks.

Ordinary armies had already retreated thousands of miles, and those armies composed of seven-star strength arms also hid far away and did not dare to enter the battle range of the great warriors.

At this time, the nine-star arms of the Zerg and Protoss began to play an important role.

The nine-star Zerg Queen and Scorpion both have the ability to kill a great warrior with one blow.

The nine-star Protoss Light Archon and Dark Archon both have the ability to easily kill a great warrior.

Other nine-star Zerg and Protoss arms also have the ability to fight against each other.

With the support of sufficient system resources, Wu Qing hatched and materialized a large number of nine-star Zerg and Protoss arms and put them into the battlefield of great power.

With the participation of the Zerg and Protoss troops that can quickly eliminate the powerful warriors of the evil god camp, the local camp once again stabilized the front line.

The one-hit kill capability of the Zerg and Protoss troops also reduced the damage caused to the world by the unlimited fighting of powerful warriors.
